title: UniformInverseAffineSectionsBound
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, with $S$ quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme]. There exists $N\in\mathbf N$, $N>0$, such that for every affine open $U\subset S$ and quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ [pqf-def-coherent], the right derived functors of $\Gamma(f^{-1}U,-)$ vanish on $M$ in every degree $p\ge N$. Sections and their cohomology are the module-section functor and its right derived functors [def-sc-open-module-cohomology].

proof.text: Use lem-pc-local-uniform-higher-direct-image-bound to choose V(s), n(s), with s in V(s), uniformly for all quasi-coherent M. Compactness of S gives a finite set t of points whose chosen opens cover S. Set N=max(1,sup_{s in t} n(s)).

If p >= N, the p-th higher direct image of any quasi-coherent M restricts to zero on every V(s) for s in t. Apply the existing proved Scheme.Modules.isZero_of_iSup_eq_top to this cover, yielding a zero higher direct image globally. The finite supremum inequality establishes every required local degree bound.

For affine U, apply lem-pc-affine-open-higher-direct-image-sections-iso. The additive section functor on S maps the zero higher direct image to a zero abelian group. Transport this vanishing across the comparison isomorphism. Since N >= 1 it is positive, including an empty finite subcover.
